purpose.zh: 练肩部上举和外旋控制，打开胸椎和肩
purpose.en: Train overhead shoulder control and open up the upper back and shoulders.

text.en: Keep your forearms near the wall and slide from a W up to a Y

text.zh: 后脑、背部和臀部贴墙，肋骨下沉
text.en: Keep your head, back and hips on the wall, with your ribs down.

text.zh: 滑到手肘接近伸直，再慢慢滑回W
text.en: Slide up until your elbows are almost straight, then slowly back down to the W.

commonErrors.zh: 腰部离墙拱起、肋骨外翻
commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back off the wall and flaring the ribs.
Letting the arms drift forward off the wall.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小上滑幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Slide up less if your shoulders hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
